Built to survive updates

🌐

Network first

Most plugins run in a local proxy that rewrites Discord's traffic. A client update cannot break them.

🎨

UI when it can

A small in-process loader adds themes, a settings tab and on-screen extras. If an update moves things, only the UI turns off.

🧩

Sandboxed plugins

Third-party plugins are WASM packages with declared rights. Install them without rebuilding, remove them with one command.

🔒

Yours only

The certificate is generated on your machine, limited to Discord's domains and never leaves it. No telemetry, ever.

🔄

Updates itself

Installed copies pick up signed releases on their own and verify every file before installing.

🗂️

Bring your setup

Plugin names match Vencord's, so your settings import one to one, and Vencord themes convert with one command.
